fusions.name: Drowsy Drones
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stings at once, spread apart, each of which deals 2 poison damage, with a 30% chance per hit to leave the target [Hindered] for 5 seconds. [Hindered] is catching: it passes to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Honeyed Barb
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 6 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and slows it by 25% for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Let the Hive Work
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds. A swarm of bees fights beside you for 9 seconds, stinging for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Idle Hands, Busy Wings
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, a bee flies to the nearest enemy within 7 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
